I really like this cream — it has a pleasantly rich but lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. It feels smooth and hydrating on the skin, and it layers perfectly under sunscreen or makeup. My skin stays soft and moisturized throughout the day. What I love most is that it’s completely fragrance-free. For me, that’s a big plus — facial creams don’t need any added scent, especially for sensitive skin. This one feels pure, non-irritating, and very gentle. It doesn’t cause redness or breakouts, even on delicate areas. After a week of use, I’ve noticed that my skin tone looks more even, pores appear smaller, and my face feels smoother and healthier. It also gives a subtle brightening effect without feeling heavy. The tube design is hygienic and easy to control, which helps avoid wasting product. The only thing I wish for is a larger size — 35 ml runs out quickly because I use it every day. Considering the quality and ingredients like niacinamide and tranexamic acid, the price is very reasonable — definitely great value for money. I have combination and sensitive skin, and it works perfectly without irritation. Overall, it’s a well-balanced, hydrating, and effective cream. I’ll definitely repurchase it once I finish this tube. Highly recommended for anyone with sensitive or uneven skin tone looking for a gentle brightening cream.
